208.explanation:
This was a verified no-show: the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 6.40.

What the record shows. The driver's 10-second GPS trace (EV-GPS-00208) puts his vehicle inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at The Interlace guardhouse from 16:02:10, and he held position there continuously for 585 seconds until 16:11:55 — 285 seconds more than the 300-second free waiting period in force for this RYDE_XL trip under the trip record's platform policy (EV-TRIP-00208). The 'arrived' marker at 16:02:25 sits inside that run with only 15 seconds of skew, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises — with no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them.

Rider, on your account. Your statement that the driver never came is not borne out, and your advocate rightly did not press it. Your own device track (EV-GPS-00208) never moves and stays 634–646 m from the pickup pin, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius — you were not at the guardhouse pickup point while the driver waited. POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate you: limb (b) fails because the driver replied 18 seconds after your 16:08:02 message and placed an answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40 (EV-CHAT-00208, EV-TRIP-00208), and limb (c) fails on your own fixes. POL-NS-06 cannot help you, because the dwell exceeded the free waiting period, and no traffic advisory exists to change that (EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). Your reading of POL-NS-01's 'fixes inside the radius' sentence is rejected: read with the clause's own note, that sentence is the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome only, and the driver here used RIDER_NO_SHOW. The arrival marker was not false — the driver was stationary 28.8 m from the pin at 0 km/h — so POL-NS-05 does not fire and the waiting clock runs from the genuine arrival. Because the clauses do license an outcome, there is no gap for POL-GEN-07 to fill and no basis for escalation.

Driver compensation and the profiles. Because the fee is chargeable and nothing displaces it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80% of the SGD 8.00 fee — SGD 6.40 — the residual 20% retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/143 = 0.014 (below 0.08), and both limbs must be met. Under POL-GEN-03 a ruling that pays the driver is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd carries the same figure, SGD 6.40. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the admissible artifacts agree with one another, there is no shared-party dispute history, the anti-farming check is not tripped, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3). Your prior_no_show_flags of 3, your rating, cancellation rate and prior dispute counters are context only under POL-GEN-01 and are not used as a ground against you.

Integrity and confidence. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): the trace has 100% coverage and a 0.0 s maximum gap, the chat log carries the 6 messages the trip record counts, the SGD 8.00 fare line reconciles to the platform figure, and the clock skew is 15 seconds. The deciding facts rest on artifacts of full weight (1.0), so confidence is set at 0.95.

Referrals and next steps. No clause produces a referral here: the arrival marker was not false (POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire) and the POL-NS-07 check did not trip. Your request for someone to call you is noted in this ruling; it does not itself create a referral, but you retain the right to ask for a human decision (POL-GEN-08(3)) and the appeal route under POL-GEN-04. The monetary effect, SGD 6.40, is within the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

103.explanation:
Rider and driver: this is my decision on trip TRP-00103 (14 July, Bishan to Kallang Wave Mall).

WHAT THE EVIDENCE SHOWS. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00103) ran 11.18 km against the booked optimal of 8.2 km (EV-TRIP-00103) — an excess of 2.98 km, or 36.3%. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs, not the trip record's rounded 11.2 km copy. That clears both establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so a deviation is established. It does not reach the 50% / 8.0 km materiality lines, so no MATERIAL deviation is recorded on this trip.

DISTANCE — NO REFUND. The LTA advisory ADV-20260714-031 (EV-ADVIS-00103-01) closes Braddell Road (towards Serangoon) between Lorong 1 Toa Payoh and Bishan Rd from 05:30 to 12:00, which covers the trip window, and the trace runs inside the closure geometry. Under POL-RD-03 the justified excess is min(2.98 km, 1.30 x (10.6 - 8.2) + 1.00 = 4.12 km) = 2.98 km, so the entire measured excess is exonerated. There is no excess beyond that cap, so POL-RD-02 does not run and the distance and time charges stand. The $4.15 figure both sides put forward is the POL-RD-02 arithmetic against the closure-adjusted optimal; it does not govern here, because POL-RD-02 applies only where no exculpatory clause fully excuses the deviation, and POL-RD-03 excuses it in full. Likewise the unadjusted $8.49 comparison is not in play.

ERP — $4.00 REFUNDED. The fare (EV-FARE-00103) carries $4.00 of ERP: CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) $3.00 and CTE (Moulmein Rd towards City) $1.00, against an optimal-route ERP of $0.00. Both gantries are genuinely crossed — the trace passes 0.0 m and 40.25 m from them, inside the 250 m match radius of POL-RD-09(4) — so this is not a phantom-line billing defect and no billing-integrity referral arises. But neither gantry is on the route the rider booked. Under POL-RD-09(2), where the deviation is exonerated as an external event under POL-RD-03, the distance and time charges stand while off-route ERP is refunded to the rider as a standalone pass-through correction, capped at $12.00 per trip. The rider did not cause the closure and did not choose the expressway. I therefore refund the off-route ERP of $4.00.

DRIVER'S RIDER-AUTHORISATION ARGUMENT (POL-RD-04 / POL-RD-09(3)) — REJECTED. The driver's message announced the diversion ('braddell close today, i take CTE ah', 08:12:30) and the rider answered 'ok' (08:12:58), but POL-RD-04 requires a RIDER instruction that identifies a place or road specifically enough to act on. The rider's reply names no place or road, and neither message carries a waypoint_hint. POL-RD-04's test therefore cannot be run on this record, the clause is unavailable, and the exchange is not a rider-caused detour. POL-RD-09(3) does not bar the ERP refund.

DRIVER'S NO_ACTION ARGUMENT — REJECTED. Leaving the fare entirely as charged would keep the $4.00 of off-route ERP that POL-RD-09(2) directs be returned.

NO ESCALATION, NO COMPENSATION, NO REFERRALS. Trip identifiers match across the trip record, trace and fare breakdown; the trace is clean (175 fixes, 10 s interval, no gaps, max_gap 0 s, 100% coverage, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) is not met); the advisory is present and current; and the refund is far below the $150 ceiling. No repeat-deviation pattern exists (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d 0 against 553 completed trips_90d), so no POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral applies. No driver compensation is due: the fare billed no less distance than the trace records. The rider's own profile shows deviation_claims_60d 0, so no extra corroboration is demanded.

RESULT. PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 4.00 to the rider (the off-route ERP pass-through under POL-RD-09(2)); the contested amount was SGD 9.00. The distance and time charges stand. This refund is within the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

901.explanation:
To the rider (R-7823): your $5.00 no-show cancellation fee is upheld and stands charged, and $4.00 of it is paid to the driver. To the driver (D-2398): your fee stands and your payout is confirmed at $4.00.

What decides the case. Trip TRIP-2026-09945 was booked 08:30, the driver assigned 08:30:15, and the platform recorded its own arrival measurement at 08:43:00 — 'Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed.' — because trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO. The platform then notified the rider at 08:43:05, started the free 5-minute wait timer at 08:43:10, called the rider in-app at 08:47:05 (22 s, unanswered), marked the free wait expired at 08:48:10, and terminated the trip at 08:51:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, charging the $5.00 fee (EV-TRIP-00901). POL-NS-12 applies: with a GPS_AUTO marker, the platform's own arrival event (distance and speed) plus wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired are its full-resolution measurement and an independent carrier for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) — arrival is established at 08:43:00, and the free waiting period is established as served at 08:48:10. No admissible fix places the driver outside the arrival radius or moving at 15 km/h, so the POL-NS-12 exception and POL-NS-05 do not fire. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full: (a) an 'arrived' event exists; (b) arrival is established from the platform's own measurement; (c) the dwell from 08:43:10 to 08:48:10 is the 300 s platform_policy.free_wait_sec requires, and the 08:51:00 cancellation is 480 s after arrival, meeting platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec of 480 s; (d) no boarding was recorded and the driver terminated with RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee, so POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout.

The rider's arguments, answered. The rider's case rests on the exported trace EV-GPS-00901, which is impaired (weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) and reports no horizontal accuracy on any of its eight fixes. The rider argues that under POL-NS-02 no qualifying in-radius fix exists, so the driver never arrived and limb (b) fails, and that under POL-NS-06 the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the required 300 s, so the fee must be fully refunded. Both are rejected. POL-NS-12 is directed at exactly this situation: a sparse or accuracy-less export does not impair the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events, which establish arrival and the waiting period served. The derived qualifying_fix_count of 0 and accumulated_dwell of 0 s are the 25 m accuracy filter operating on an export that reports no accuracy at all, not measurements that the driver was elsewhere; under POL-NS-02 an accuracy-less fix is evidence of neither presence nor absence. There is no waiting-period shortfall for POL-NS-06 to refund. The rider's point that POL-NS-12 does not reach POL-NS-06 is not accepted: POL-NS-12 establishes the free waiting period as served for POL-NS-01 limb (c), and POL-NS-06's shortfall test is measured against that period, so it finds nothing to refund. The rider is correct that the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00901-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) makes POL-NS-06 limb (i) unavailable, but it decides nothing because there is no shortfall to accumulate across. The rider is also correct that no rider track was supplied, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE and neutral under POL-NS-11 rather than adverse — and that too decides nothing, because the fee rests on the driver's evidence. The rider is right that the chat log EV-CHAT-00901 holds no rider message (all six entries are the driver's or the system's) so POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails and cannot exonerate the rider; the driver's in-app call and messages defeat limb (b) in any event.

The driver's case, answered. I accept that the fee stands and that POL-NS-07 fixes the payout: 80 percent of the $5.00 fee in force (read from trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd as fee_schedule.resolution_rule directs) is $4.00, which the fare ledger's derived money block also computes (EV-FARE-00901, impaired, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD). The anti-farming check does not withhold it: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is null, so the '4 or more' limb is not met and the check is undecidable rather than tripped. The driver is right that POL-NS-05 is not engaged (the marker was auto-confirmed at 10 m and 0 km/h and no admissible fix contradicts it), that POL-NS-03 is not reached, and that the ledger's $5.00 line equals the fee in force, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

Outcome and amounts. The rider's claim is not supported on the fee, which stays charged (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, EV-FARE-00901). Because the verified no-show also produces a driver payment, the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and under POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at $4.00 — that is the amount the ruling moves, not a refund to the filing party. The monetary effect ($4.00) is within the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00, so it executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

Confidence. The deciding facts — arrival, the waiting period served, and termination for a rider no-show — are carried by EV-TRIP-00901 (weight 1.0) and EV-CHAT-00901 (weight 1.0), which POL-NS-12 makes independent of the export; the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is therefore 1.0 and confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The impaired fare ledger (0.75) and export (0.6) do not carry the deciding facts.

Discarded claims. The referee discarded four claims for citing an impaired artifact without disclosing its issue codes; they are recorded in discarded_claims and form no part of this ruling. Nothing here turns on the rider's prior_no_show_flags of 1, which POL-GEN-01 makes context only and which is not the trailing-window field POL-NS-09(d) names.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
